d: After the Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 clash between India A and Pakistan A in Doha—where Vaibhav Suryavanshi got dismissed for 11 runs off 13 balls—Pakistan cricket fans went overboard on social media trolling the 15-year-old Indian sensation! And right after that, Vaibhav answered back in style with an insane, record-shattering knock against UAE! In this unfiltered cricket roast by Zero Cricket Knowledge (ZCK - Chayan Rastogi, Abhishek Manchanda, Prashant Kapoor), we roast the shameless trolling by Pakistan cricket fans, break down Vaibhav Suryavanshi’s fearless batting, and look ahead to…
